record.paper_title: Open Problems About Sumsets in Finite Abelian Groups: Minimum Sizes and Critical Numbers
record.context_brief: Frequency of disagreement for two-fold signed sumsets
record.original_question: Let G be a finite abelian group of order n, written additively, and let A={a1,...,am} be an m-element subset of G. For h=2, define the ordinary sumset 2A using nonnegative integer coefficients with total 2, and define the signed sumset 2±A using integer coefficients λ1,...,λm with |λ1|+...+|λm|=2. Let ρ(G,m,2) and ρ±(G,m,2) be the minimum possible sizes of these two sumsets over all m-element subsets A of G. Is it true that ρ±(G,m,2) and ρ(G,m,2) differ for fewer than n/4 values of m?

evidence.quote: h± A = {Σ_i=1^m λ_i ai | λ1,...,λm ∈ Z, Σ_i=1^m |λ_i| = h}.
ρ± (G, m, h) = min{|h± A| | A ⊆ G, |A| = m}
Conjecture 13 For any abelian group of order n, ρ± (G, m, 2) and ρ (G, m, 2) disagree for fewer than n/4 values of m.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $n$, written additively, and let $m$ be a positive integer with $1 \le m \le n$. For an $m$-element subset $A = \{a_1, \dots, a_m\} \subseteq G$, define the (2-fold) ordinary sumset
$$2A = \Bigl\{ \sum_{i=1}^m \lambda_i a_i \;\Big|\; \lambda_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0},\; \sum_{i=1}^m \lambda_i = 2 \Bigr\},$$
and the (2-fold) signed sumset
$$2_\pm A = \Bigl\{ \sum_{i=1}^m \lambda_i a_i \;\Big|\; \lambda_i \in \mathbb{Z},\; \sum_{i=1}^m |\lambda_i| = 2 \Bigr\}.$$
Set
$$\rho(G,m,2) = \min\{|2A| : A \subseteq G,\ |A| = m\}, \qquad \rho_\pm(G,m,2) = \min\{|2_\pm A| : A \subseteq G,\ |A| = m\}.$$
Prove or disprove: for every finite abelian group $G$ of order $n$, the number of values $m \in \{1, 2, \dots, n\}$ for which $\rho_\pm(G, m, 2) \ne \rho(G, m, 2)$ is strictly less than $n/4$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as an open problem in surveys of minimum sumset sizes. Bajnok and Matzke initiated detailed study of ρ±(G,m,h) and obtained equality results in particular cases (e.g., cyclic groups for certain h), but no published resolution of the n/4 disagreement conjecture for h=2 in arbitrary finite abelian groups was found.

status_evidence.title: The Minimum Size of Signed Sumsets — Bajnok & Matzke
status_evidence.snippet: Initiates study of ρ±(G,m,h), establishing relationships with ρ(G,m,h) in special cases such as cyclic groups.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational results exist but the n/4 disagreement conjecture is not resolved there.

status_evidence.title: Béla Bajnok's research page
status_evidence.snippet: Lists ongoing work on minimum sumset sizes and signed sumsets.
status_evidence.claim: No announced resolution of the conjecture about ρ± and ρ disagreeing for fewer than n/4 values of m.
